wake-intention-prosperity-01.title: Welcome a new day · Prosperity
wake-intention-prosperity-01.body: I awaken to new possibilities. I welcome prosperity and move forward with confidence.
paragraphs: Give prosperity a meaning that belongs to your life: freedom to choose, care for those you love, or satisfaction in what you create. Notice what already supports you and allow yourself to imagine new possibilities. Choose a step that fits your circumstances and appreciate the attention you give it.
